data.campaign_details: DOP3 is a Web3-savvy telecom wholesaler exploring blockchain adoption. They're keen to run a campaign on our platform to boost visibility and adoption. Their focus is on real-time settlements and community engagement.

Cookie3 is a Web3 marketing analytics platform that helps projects understand and target on-chain audiences. They're looking to launch a campaign on our platform to showcase their AI-driven engagement tools. Cookie3 aims to boost adoption and visibility among data-driven crypto communities.

Ethena is a Web3-native project focused on decentralized finance and synthetic assets. The team is exploring campaign opportunities on our platform to grow user adoption and educate the community. Their goal is to drive awareness around stable yield strategies in the crypto space.
